content_en: Based on a study of 362 sample buildings, using a small set of buildings (three or more) represents the retrofit effect of a building stock better than a single archetype building
content_ko: 1개의 대표건물 (archetype)보다, 소수 건물(3개 이상)이 해당 건물군의 리트로핏 효과를 잘 표현할 수 있음을, 실제 362개 샘플 건물을 통해 연구.

content_en: I introduced the philosophy, principles, and usage of EnergyStudio to members of the KIBEA, followed by an in-depth discussion on necessary improvements for the tool's future adoption.
